reason: The first reading was already nearly complete; the Latin fixed the order of the pages, confirmed doubtful words on the three pages reread and showed which underlined passages are lemmata of the Rule.
sources: Expositio in regulam beati Augustini, printed among the works of Hugh of St Victor, PL 176 (Paris 1854), cols 899-904 (chapters 6-7), https://archive.org/details/bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_1854_176 leaves n449-n451; page images for cols 901-904, machine-read text for cols 899-900

text:
F-n8nv, source-assisted reading. Reread on the images by a research reader with the Latin of the Expositio in regulam S. Augustini (PL 176, cols 899-904) at hand: fol. [2]v, fol. [4]v and fol. [3]r. The lines given from fol. [5]v, [3]v and [4]r are taken from the image-only first reading and were not reread. Not an independent reading. Accuracy has not been measured.
Conventions: (..) expansion; [..] lost or supplied; ? uncertain; UL = underlined in red. One manuscript line per line. Boxes are native pixels.

CANVAS 1 (4711 x 3851), left page, fol. [2]v, box 200,250,2400,2300. Reread.
 1  dien dat wij sondighe(n) ontfaen va(n)

 4  nouchte(n) ghehoude(n) werde(n) recht
 5  als m(et) eene(n) bande d(er) noet Da(er) o(m)me
 6  eist goet wa(n)neer de sonde beghint
 7  te openbaerne dat me(n)se da(n) corri-      (small letters added below "mense")
 8  giere Want beghint su ? meerre(n) ?

10  sonde(n) En(de) want die psalme seit va(n)
